text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the shopping district,
I spotted El Condor Pasa holding her head in distress.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
You came at the perfect time!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm actually in the middle of a battle against an ancient manuscript!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sì! Today was my turn on cooking duty,
so I went down to the dorm kitchen, but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And then, of all things!
Squeezed between the shelves, I found an ancient tome
called the "Top Secret Recipeee"!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: As expected of an ancient text, though! Characters are missing all over the place—it's practically like a puzzle!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yes! This must surely be a challenge left by the Miho Dormitory upperclassmen for us underclassmen!

And thus, I was shown the ancient tome—
a notebook titled 'Secret Recipes'—however...
Parts of it are unreadable due to moth holes, but anyone could tell it's a curry recipe.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thinking normally, that is indeed true, YES!
Even El could easily figure that out!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
However, there is no way our senior would give us
such an easy challenge!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In the game I played the other day, the treasure chest right by the entrance was a monster in disguise too!
I won't be fooled again!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El bets the secret lies in the missing parts scattered throughout the ancient text, desu!
choice_data_list: I think it's just moth-eaten or something, though...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That can't be true!
They must have hidden it on purpose, without a doubt!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even with the first part missing for "'tato,"
I think a regular potato is far too simple, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
This "i" looks a bit small, meaning
the word written here was—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ultimo! Yes! It's a message from Senpai
telling us to use "ultimo" ingredients, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No! You can't beat Senpai like that!
To win, we must read between the lines!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now then! What could possibly have been written
on this blank page next...?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: From El's perspective, I think it's referring to a super-spicy spice that isn't listed here, de-su, but—

And so, in the name of a challenge,
El Condor Pasa bought ingredients based entirely
on her own unique interpretation...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All the ingredients are ready to go!
Total victory for El so far!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Now, if everyone at the dorm eats this and loves it, it'll be El's complete and total victory, desu!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, El. And El's Trainer as well.
You were late getting back, so I was starting to worry, you know?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So, were you able to buy all the ingredients properly?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Of course! It's a complete and total victory for El, desu!!

And so, after explaining the ancient text containing
the "secret recipe" and the mystery-solving
details to Grass Wonder in full depth...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"This recipe... no matter how you look at it,
I'm pretty sure it's just normal curry...?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You're too naive too, Grass, desu! That's a trap from our senpais!
You can't win if you just take everything at face value!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Haa... But El, I think a total victory means everyone in the dorm gets to enjoy a delicious meal, don't you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡Sí! That goes without saying, yeees!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Then if you use ingredients this super-spicy,
people who can't handle spice won't be able to eat it...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Geh?! N-No way...?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's no good!
I-I have to do something about this...!!
choice_data_list: Let's prep everything again for everyone's sake!
Maybe I should add some sugar to sweeten it...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You're right! We still have time!
I'll go buy ingredients for regular curry, *desu*!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All right, the riddle-solving game is over!
From here on out—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's a racing game!
El has not lost ye~eeet!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu, for better or worse, you always give it your all...
Afterward, El Condor Pasa bought normal ingredients and achieved a brilliant, total victory.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I see! I hadn't thought of that!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That won't work...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Come on, I'll help you out,
so let's go buy some normal ingredients.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah, u-umm... yes desu...

And so, El Condor Pasa set off once more
with Grass Wonder to buy ingredients...
